news.label: Google Releases Three-Live
details: Three-Live lets you deploy AI-generated, Three.js-based 3D scenes to WebGL2 and WebXR, Android, and iOS and visionOS.
To make that possible, it includes a runtime and a native JIT compiler.

lines.say: First up, Google has released Three-Live as open source.
lines.show: First up, Google has released Three-Live as open source.

lines.say: It lets you run three D scenes created by A I straight on the web and on X R devices.
lines.show: It lets you run AI-created 3D scenes directly on the web and XR devices.

lines.say: It's still a developer preview for now.
lines.show: It's still a developer preview for now.

link.title: Introducing Three-Live: turning AI-generated Three.js into interactive 3D, AR, and WebXR across web and mobile
link.description: Meet Three-Live: an Apache 2.0 library and on-device Rust/Boa compiler turning AI-generated Three.js code into glTF 2.0, USDZ, and WebXR in ≤ 50 KB.

news.label: AssetFurnace 0.5.7 Update
details: This update fixes 3D engine compatibility for environments that were installed in the past.
The background removal model is now lighter.
The progress display has been improved so long-running jobs no longer look like they've stalled.

lines.say: Next, an update to Asset Furnace.
This tool creates three D characters from images right on your own machine, and it's now lighter and more stable.
lines.show: This tool makes 3D characters from images locally, and it's now lighter and more stable.

lines.say: The progress display is also easier to follow.
lines.show: The progress display is also easier to follow.

news.label: FluidNinja LIVE-2 Released
points: Water, smoke, fire, clouds, sand, snow
Works with terrain and Chaos debris
details: It has been rebuilt on a new architecture centered on Niagara Simulation Stages.
It simulates water, smoke, fire, clouds, sand, and snow.
Interaction with terrain, objects, and Chaos debris has been strengthened.

lines.say: Third, we have Fluid Ninja Live Two, a fluid effects tool for Unreal Engine.
lines.show: Third, FluidNinja LIVE-2, a fluid effects tool for Unreal Engine.

lines.say: Water, smoke, and fire now swirl and interact properly with terrain and objects.
lines.show: Water, smoke, and fire now interact properly with terrain and objects.

lines.say: It sounds like a great fit for showcase projects too.
lines.show: It sounds like a great fit for showcase projects too.

news.label: mGear 5.4 Series Updated
points: Rig building about twice as fast
details: The update adds Facial Rigger 3.0 and Anim Picker 2.0.
Spring Manager 2.0 and other tools have been added as well.
Rig building with Shifter is about twice as fast. A 5.4.4 hotfix also came out on October twenty-seventh.

lines.say: Now, an update to m Gear, the rigging toolset for Maya.
lines.show: Now, an update to mGear, the rigging toolset for Maya.

lines.say: There's a new facial rig, and building rigs is about twice as fast.
lines.show: There's a new facial rig, and building rigs is about twice as fast.

lines.say: Getting your characters ready to move just got a lot easier.
lines.show: Getting your characters ready to move just got a lot easier.

news.label: NVIDIA Releases SAGE
details: SAGE understands the task and generates the layout and object placement.
The code and the SAGE-10k dataset have been released.
It self-corrects environments while evaluating semantic plausibility, appearance, and physical stability.

lines.say: And last, SAGE, released by NVIDIA and its collaborators.
lines.show: And last, SAGE, released by NVIDIA and its collaborators.

lines_timed.show: Good morning, and welcome to Mono Radio. It's Wednesday, November 4.
Today we have five stories about AI and 3D.
First up, Google has released Three-Live as open source.
It lets you run AI-created 3D scenes directly on the web and XR devices.
It's still a developer preview for now.
This tool makes 3D characters from images locally, and it's now lighter and more stable.
The progress display is also easier to follow.
Third, FluidNinja LIVE-2, a fluid effects tool for Unreal Engine.
Water, smoke, and fire now interact properly with terrain and objects.
It sounds like a great fit for showcase projects too.
Now, an update to mGear, the rigging toolset for Maya.
There's a new facial rig, and building rigs is about twice as fast.
Getting your characters ready to move just got a lot easier.
And last, SAGE, released by NVIDIA and its collaborators.
AI automatically builds 3D environments for training robots.
And it reviews and fixes the environments it creates on its own.
Today's highlights: Three-Live and SAGE. 3D is expanding into environments AI uses.
That's all for now. See you next time on Mono Radio!
